scenes.text: This scene carries far too much on-screen copy for a single frame, because somebody pasted the whole paragraph from the script into the text field instead of a short headline, and now it keeps going for many more words than any viewer could read before the next scene arrives and replaces it entirely.
西安钟楼位于西安市中心，始建于明代洪武十七年，是中国现存钟楼中形制最大、保存最完整的一座。登上城楼，四条大街一览无余，东西南北四个方向的城门与钟楼遥相呼应，构成了古城的基本格局。夜晚灯火通明，游人如织，是西安最有代表性的地标之一。
